Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps:
Navigate to login page
Enter valid username and password
Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to the dashboard and a welcome message is shown

Title: Login with incorrect password
Steps:
Navigate to login page
Enter valid username and incorrect password
Click Login
Expected Result: An "Invalid username or password" error is shown and the user stays on the login page

Title: Password reset via email link
Preconditions: User has an active account with a verified email
Steps:
Click "Forgot password"
Enter the account email
Submit the form
Open the reset link from the email
Expected Result: A password reset form is shown and the user can set a new password

Title: Account lockout after repeated failed logins
Steps: Attempt login with wrong password 5 times in a row
Expected Result: The account is locked and a "Too many attempts" message is shown

Title: Search returns relevant results for a valid query
Steps:
Enter a known product name in the search box
Submit the search
Expected Result: Matching products are shown ranked by relevance

Title: Search with no matching results
Steps:
Enter a nonsense query with no matches
Submit the search
Expected Result: A "No results found" message is shown with suggested categories

Title: Search filters narrow results correctly
Preconditions: Product catalog has indexed items across categories
Steps:
Search for a broad term
Apply a category filter
Apply a price range filter
Expected Result: Only products matching all applied filters are shown

Title: Add item to cart from search results
Preconditions: User is logged in and viewing search results
Steps: Click "Add to cart" on a search result
Expected Result: The item appears in the cart with quantity 1 and the cart count updates

Title: Checkout with a valid saved card
Preconditions: Account has a valid saved payment card and items in cart
Steps:
Proceed to checkout
Select the saved card
Confirm payment
Expected Result: Payment is authorized and an order confirmation is shown

Title: Checkout blocked when cart is empty
Steps: Navigate directly to the checkout page
Expected Result: User is redirected to the cart page with a message that the cart is empty

Title: Apply a valid promo code at checkout
Preconditions: Cart has items and a valid unused promo code exists
Steps:
Enter the promo code at checkout
Apply the code
Expected Result: The discount is applied and the order total updates correctly

Title: Apply an expired promo code
Preconditions: Cart has items and an expired promo code exists
Steps:
Enter the expired promo code at checkout
Apply the code
Expected Result: A "This code has expired" message is shown and no discount is applied

Title: Update profile display name
Steps:
Navigate to profile settings
Change the display name
Save changes
Expected Result: The new display name is saved and shown across the app

Title: Upload a profile picture
Steps:
Navigate to profile settings
Upload a valid image file
Save changes
Expected Result: The new profile picture is displayed immediately after saving

Title: Reject unsupported file type for profile picture
Steps:
Navigate to profile settings
Attempt to upload a .txt file as a profile picture
Expected Result: An error message states only image files are supported and no upload occurs
